stage2.text:
PLAN "12-Week General Strength for Post-L4-L5 Herniation"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary general_strength:
    name "Build general strength safely post-disc herniation"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Accessory/Core":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 3m
